label: GO
call: Option B: get engaged now and marry in 9 to 12 months, once the talks are written, one shared budget has held for six months, and the wedding fits under $10K cash.

why.point: Engagement commits to the person now; marriage, the one-way door, waits for the checks.
Talks show plans; only months on a shared budget show behavior in a bad month.
A small cash wedding with six months of reserves removes the money risk.
Waiting two to three years adds time but no information.

minority.quote: A small cash wedding at month 6 is as good as B if the gate passes.
minority.would_have_to_be_true: Three straight months on one budget within 10% of plan, full balance sheets shared, and one hard month already handled well.

next_steps.action: Swap full balance sheets and each write three deal-breakers.
Four talks (money, kids, city, careers) written and signed; shared budget running since 2026-11-01.
After six budget months, lock a date for July to October 2027.

kill_criteria: A deal-breaker unresolved in 90 days, or the budget missed 3 of 6 months: stop and book nothing.
conditions: Four talks written and signed by 2027-01-22
Six months on one shared budget, kept 5 of 6, no new debt
One real disagreement settled and holding 60 days later
Wedding at or under $10K cash, 6 months of expenses left after

fights.crux: Marry in about 6 months, or engage now and marry later?
fights.story: Round 1 was unanimous for 12 to 18 months. Bezos and Hormozi argued marrying soon at full strength, then conceded three months is too small a sample. Everyone shortened B to 9 to 12 months; A rose to 5.9 but stayed behind.
Both. Talks settle facts in 3 months; about 6 months on one budget shows behavior. Hormozi wanted 3 budget months, the rest 6; the Chair picked 6.

fights.crux: What stops an engagement pushing past a red flag?
fights.story: All four proposed the same rule: no nonrefundable deposit until checks pass, and a red flag moves the date automatically.

cheapest_test: Each writes one page on money, kids, city, and careers in ten years; swap and read before talking.
revisit: May 2027, with six months of budget results, the signed one-pagers, and the wedding budget.
override_note: Quick mode: Round 3 skipped because the spread on B was 0 and no seat was at ruin risk likely.
